question: How many artists are in the database?
Which artist has the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the 5 genres with the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: Total revenue for each billing country
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spend? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS spend FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 5

question: What was total revenue in 2013?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2013'

question: Total revenue per year
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY year

question: What is the name of the longest track?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many employees live in Calgary?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE City = 'Calgary'

question: Which sales support agent's customers generated the most revenue? Give the agent's first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which playlists have no tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE pt.PlaylistId IS NULL

question: What is the average length in seconds of Rock tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 1000.0 FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

question: How many customers do not have a company listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NULL

question: What was our revenue last quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2013-07-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2013-10-01'
